test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'them'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pronoun required to fill the blank is referring to '**all the children**' which is a third-person plural reference.
 
• '**Them**' is the correct pronoun for third-person plural objects which fits the context.
 
• The other options, 'her', 'him', and 'you' do not agree in number and person as required by the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Them' is an objective case pronoun in English, used for a group or more than one person.
